name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Financial Assistance For Funeral of the Artist
benefit: - Financial assistance of up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- shall be sanctioned to meet expenses in connection with the funeral of the Goan artist. - The benefit is provided as a one-time lump sum grant. - The financial assistance amount shall be disbursed to the eligible member of artist's family in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a family member of the deceased artist. - The deceased artist must have been born and brought up in Goa. - The deceased artist must have been recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. - The family income of the deceased artist (from all sources) must not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum. - The applicant must not have claimed or received funeral assistance benefits from any other government source for the same purpose.
